assessor: RTS governed build assessment — Catalog Cost False-Green Repair v1
rationale: K2 independently reproduced a concrete false green: descriptive catalog wording containing a cost cue is promoted by K1 into RECALIBRATE_LIMIT_OR_BUDGET active work. The repair surface is localized to K1 second-pass route recovery plus regression expectations. The change is high risk-reduction, low effort, and directly testable by the existing K2 held-out, mutation, metamorphic, and harness lanes.

queries: human escalation gate cost pricing route

assets.notes: Existing independent held-out oracle should turn from failed to passed without changing the held-out expected outcome.

gaps: K1 cost-route currently treats any cost cue in a K0 HUMAN_NOW anchor as active recalibration work.
No direct K1 regression distinguishes descriptive cost adjectives from operational pricing/billing contracts.

risks: A too-broad guard could suppress legitimate pricing/billing verification.
A literal held-out special-case could overfit instead of fixing the semantic boundary.
Changing K1 source can make K2 mutation operators stale; stale operators must HOLD rather than be ignored.
